description: Nine positions of the two-object VLM dataset (a 3x3 subset of the single-object grid) and the check of every position pair for every shape pair. Generated by render_two_object_dataset.py.

grid.row_order: position_id = row * 3 + col; row 0 is the top (farthest) row, col 0 the left column

criteria.checks: silhouettes (supersampled masks of each object rendered alone) must not overlap and must be at least min_gap_px apart; footprints on the ground at least min_world_gap apart
